sources.claim: Approval grant is event.source or event.name in context.variables; Always reuse does not include arguments or a time bound, and denials do not call the continuation.
Maintainer tests assert same-name implementation separation, persistence on later turns and reuse after variables JSON roundtrip. Tests were read, not executed.
FunctionTool source uses module, qualname and exposed name; registration overwrites the event source on a copy before middleware execution.
Context.ask correlates a human reply by parent_id and applies timeout around send plus wait; reserved variable filtering excludes ag:/a2a: keys. Transport coverage is unverified.
findApproval SQL matches agent and workflow pattern inside a created_at window but omits request_id despite its comment; createApprovalRequest stores request_id in metadata.
Approval PAUSE/BLOCK short-circuits the pipeline; pending approval-ID lookup separately uses JSON request_id. Fail-closed exception handling can return audit ID -1 if audit writing fails.

The exact pinned SQL returns the same approved row for request A and request B/target B; different-agent, workflow, age and status controls exclude it. Newest eligible record wins. Nine SQL cases executed.

The actual pinned FunctionTool.source getter returns equal strings for different bodies retaining module/qualname/exposed name, unequal strings for distinct qualnames or aliases; three AST-isolated cases executed.
